description: MainActivity class for an Android TV application that hosts an HTML homepage within a WebView. Responsible for loading the local assets page, configuring WebView settings, and handling remote control input interactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for Android TV app hosting a WebView for displaying a local homepage HTML file.

methods.name: loadHome
methods.description: Loads the homepage HTML file from app assets into the WebView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up WebView with specific settings, assigns clients, and loads the home page.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles remote control key events, mapping DPAD_CENTER and ENTER to trigger WebView click, and back navigation.
